biology.name: Biology
biology.label: Biology

psychology.label: Psychology

extended_investigation.name: Extended Investigation
extended_investigation.label: Extended Investigation
extended_investigation.notes: 2025 CTT /50 (2025 report question marks sum to 50), 10% of study score. EAT (GA3 /200) = written report /60 (36%) + oral presentation /40 (24%) = 100 marks total, 60% of study score; the two are separate marks but one GA3, so the page can combine them (raw/100). Older CTT raw: 2014 37 (GA 74), 2016-2018 38 (GA 76), 2015 and 2019-2024 40 (GA 80); covers 2014/2016/2017/2018 read from images, 2015 inferred from GA 80. Older EAT raw not checked; GA3 /200 constant, so 100 assumed. 2014 era study design differed (Extended Investigation 2014+ ... current design from 2025).

dance.name: Dance
dance.label: Dance
dance.notes: Performance: 16 criteria (8 per solo), each scored 0-10 in the 2023, 2024 and 2025 reports = 160 raw. The catalog's GA2 scale varies by year (480, 240 in 2020, 160 in 2024, 320 in 2025) while the raw 16x10 structure is the same in 2023-2025; 2020 (COVID) may have had fewer criteria, not verified. Specs do not state a raw performance total. Written spec: total 80.

vet_dance_vce_vet.label: VET Dance
